function.name: _codestudio_list_modules
function.description: List all existing AICodeStudio modules under the current app (returns a list of moduleId / name / remark). [IMPORTANT] Before calling _codestudio_create_module to create a new module, you MUST call this first: if an existing AICodeStudio module fits the purpose, reuse its moduleId instead of creating a duplicate; only create a new module when none is suitable.
